title: Lahoo Lahoo
body:
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ki beti ke dil ke tukde hai jaa ba jaa
khaak o khoon mein lathde
hai barchiyon mein koi kaleja
churi ke neeche koi gala hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap utha alqama ka pani
guzar gaya fatema ka jaani
baras raha hai lahoo falak se
zameene maqtal ko zalzala hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na paas ammu hai aur na baba
kise ab awaaz de sakina
koi layeen cheenta hai baali
koi rida le ke jaa raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb hai bekasi ka manzar
na koi monis na koi yawar
jo laash bhai ki bekafan hai
to sar behan ka bhi berida hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun bachi hai mehwe zaari
hai jiske kaano se khoon jaari
kahan ho ammu madad ko aao
layeen tamache laga raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhuan dhuan hai qayaam saare
ali ki beti kise pukaare
kahin pe bistar jhulas raha hai
kahin pe jhoola sulag raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khuda kaun kis ko roye
hai sab ke sab apni jaan khoye
kisi ke baazu kate huwe hai
kisi ka baazu bandha hua hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda e ghairat kathin hai saa'at
nawaz zainab ke dil ko quwwat
dayaar e karbobala se aage
abhi to kufe ka saamna hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
azan e gham de raha hai aamir
karam hai kadiyal jawan ka nayyar
kalaam mera likh raha hai nauha
bureeda shaano ki ye ata hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
